instruction: Show me how to set Thunderbird to instantly mark emails as read upon clicking them, without any delay.

metadata.explanation: This task requires configuring Thunderbird to mark messages as read immediately when selected, without delay. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs function to verify that the preference 'mailnews.mark_message_read.delay' is set to false. This is a common preference configuration task with similar difficulty to the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM using get_vm_file getter
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses Mozilla preference format and extracts mailnews.mark_message_read.delay value
Expected value (delay=false) semantically matches instruction requirement for immediate message marking
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage: single requirement (enable immediate marking) fully verified by checking the correct preference
Data flow is correct: file retrieval -> preference parsing -> rule-based comparison
Metric correctly handles None return value from getter (returns 0.0 if file retrieval fails)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Static type warning about get_vm_file return type (Union) vs metric parameter (str) is handled correctly at runtime but could be clarified in type annotations

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
